name: Digjam Limited
about: Digjam Limited engages in the manufacture and marketing of fabrics for suiting and casual wear primarily in India. The company offers its fabrics under the DIGJAM brand. Digjam Limited was formerly known as Digjam Textiles Limited and changed its name to Digjam Limited in March 2016. The company was founded in 1948 and is based in Mumbai, India. Digjam Limited operates as a subsidiary of Finquest Financial Solutions Private Limited.
